descriptor.capability: native-issued random 64 lowercase hex, single claim
descriptor.plugin_id: exact Elyx ID (never a filename-derived alias)
descriptor.owner_token: null for inspect; exact native CallbackOwner.wireToken otherwise
descriptor.source_sha256: 64 lowercase hex of exact issued regular-file bytes
descriptor.source_namespace: opaque native-issued 64 lowercase hex identifying held installation/staging namespace
descriptor.source_nonce: opaque native-issued 64 lowercase hex for this exact source version/receipt

authority.transport: existing retained native dispatcher; C injects pluginId/ownerToken; no legacy service registry
authority.inspector_c_identity: @elyx-inspection (only injected when C plugin_id is unset); ownerToken null

native_envelope.payload: JSON string, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes
native_envelope.pluginId: C-injected immutable id, never taken from payload

authority.execution: synchronous read-only native callback under the existing caller GIL; no Python reverse callback, actor wait, publication or interpreter creation; returned JSON buffers are copied
authority.provider_owner: native developer owner implements/installs this hook in PluginElyxDeveloperFiles.swift
authority.raw_fd: NOT an envelope field and NEVER a Python authority; descriptors/ticket duplicates remain native-owned
native_checks: exact descriptor equality against a registered unclaimed capability, not self-reported JSON
C-bound owner/purpose, live native invocation/session and source/version/namespace custody
held descriptor regular type, O_RDONLY status, size and content SHA-256
held ancestor/source device+inode and version including ctime/mtime detect replacement and ABA
independent retained duplicate/read offset per read ticket; never close on async waiter cancellation
ticket and capability cleanup at actual native invocation completion, even if Python abandons or release fails
manifest claims refer to the live native Source.open(target) receipt for this C owner and expected digest; ambiguous concurrent receipts must fail, never pick by path/digest alone

claim.request: the exact descriptor (purpose inspect or load)

manifest.reply: same shape as claim, with a native descriptor of purpose manifest; bound to registered Source.open receipt

read.reply: exact requested offset and exactly min(count, remaining) bytes; native checkCurrent before and after pinned pread

release.semantics: idempotently release only this caller's ticket; no new read authority, allowed for its retiring owner

readiness: claim must refuse unless the real FD-backed registry, inspection purpose and fresh-owner load purpose of ABI 1 are installed. load_reader_abi is a native provider contract, not a Python Boolean substitute. prepare must complete full inspect_fd_json successfully before old-owner retirement.

python_hooks.ArchiveAdapter.developer_manifest: fresh native manifest ticket -> exact verified installed source bytes -> bounded validation -> outer ZIP file SHA-256 map; no extraction walk or active cached snapshot
python_hooks.inspect_developer_descriptor: claim inspect -> bounded native FD reads -> full static archive inspection -> check -> release; returns metadata only, no cache/entry/mapping execution
python_hooks.verified_developer_load: claim load for exact fresh owner -> bounded native FD reads -> immutable validated bytes held through load_json -> check -> release; path is a label, never reopened
